nodes.name: VideoAutoNavigationSuppressor.cs
nodes.summary: Static gate that suppresses the next automatic local-video navigation event within a short expiry window, preventing duplicate navigation from playback resume.

nodes.name: WindowsVideoThumbnailExtractor.cs
nodes.summary: Extracts thumbnail images from local video files using the Windows StorageFile thumbnail API, returning a BitmapImage at a configurable size.

nodes.name: MeshGradientShader.cs
nodes.summary: ComputeSharp D2D1 pixel shader producing an animated mesh gradient from primary and accent colors for use in hero backgrounds.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ComputeSharp ID2D1PixelShader with HLSL-style intrinsics compiled by ComputeSharp at build time.

nodes.name: Resources.resw (en-US)
nodes.summary: English (US) string resource table for the WaveeMusic WinUI app, containing all localizable UI strings.

nodes.name: Resources.resw (ko-KR)
nodes.summary: Korean (KR) string resource table for the WaveeMusic WinUI app, providing Korean localization of all UI strings.

nodes.name: ButtonStyles.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML resource dictionary defining custom button styles for the WinUI app, including playback, icon, and control button variants.

nodes.name: CardStyles.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML resource dictionary defining card container styles used by ContentCard and related shelf components.

nodes.name: FluentGlyphs.cs
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for Fluent UI icon glyph codepoints used throughout the app, plus a helper to resolve social platform icons from URL/name.

nodes.name: FontResources.xaml
nodes.summary: Minimal XAML resource dictionary declaring font family resources referenced by other style dictionaries.

nodes.name: ListViewStyles.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML resource dictionary with custom ListView and ListViewItem styles for track lists and library views.

nodes.name: PlayerBarStyles.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML resource dictionary defining styles for the bottom player bar controls including transport buttons and progress slider.

nodes.name: TabBarStyles.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML resource dictionary with comprehensive tab bar and navigation item styles including Fluent animations and selection indicators.

nodes.name: VideoAutoNavigationSuppressor
nodes.summary: Static suppressor that prevents duplicate automatic video navigation by consuming a timed suppression token keyed to a track URI.

nodes.name: WindowsVideoThumbnailExtractor
nodes.summary: Extracts BitmapImage thumbnails from local video files via Windows StorageFile/StorageItemThumbnail APIs.

nodes.name: FluentGlyphs
nodes.summary: Static registry of Fluent icon PUA codepoints as named string constants, plus ResolveSocialIcon for mapping social platform URLs to their icon glyphs.

nodes.name: ResolveSocialIcon
nodes.summary: Maps a social platform URL or name to the corresponding Fluent icon glyph constant.
